current.text: He re-signed with Golden State for 2 years and 14 million USD.
He is projected to start at center while Porzingis is out.
He is expected to sit back-to-backs and play about 60 games.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
The Golden State schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.
Golden State may treat this as a gap year, worry about lottery odds and rest veterans.
One expert expects Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
One expert says to ignore him in most fantasy leagues.

durable.text: He does not play back-to-backs because of his age.
He is a low-usage big. He gives some threes and blocks with few turnovers, but few points and few steals.

note: Horford is outside our 144-player draft pool. Yahoo ranks him 211 and ESPN 199, both value him at 0 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season, so do not spend on him at the auction. He is a waiver watch for the start of the season while he starts at center in place of Porzingis. He sits every back-to-back on a team with 15 of them, so he is best used as a daily streamer on non-back-to-back days, and he loses value once Porzingis returns.
